items.headline: U.S. Stocks Tumble as Tech Sell-off Continues Amid AI Spending Concerns
items.summary: U.S. equities closed sharply lower on Monday, November 2, with the Nasdaq Composite experiencing its worst single-day percentage drop in nearly five months. Investor sentiment remained fragile due to persistent weakness in technology and AI-related shares, despite an initial market rebound driven by falling oil prices. The CBOE Volatility Index (VIX) surged, reflecting increased market apprehension ahead of the U.S. midterm elections.

items.headline: EVgo Surges on Buyout Proposal
items.summary: Shares of EVgo jumped significantly after a reported $2.00 per share cash buyout proposal.

items.headline: IDEXX Laboratories Rises on Strong Earnings and Raised Forecast
items.summary: IDEXX Laboratories ($IDXX) climbed after reporting stronger-than-expected third-quarter profit and revenue, and raising its full-year 2026 forecasts.

items.headline: Amazon.com Rallies Amid Reassessment of Cloud Growth
items.summary: Despite earlier reports of a Q3 earnings miss, Amazon.com Inc. ($AMZN) shares rallied more than 4% as investors reassessed the company's strong cloud growth.

items.headline: Lumentum Plunges on Acquisition News and AI-Related Angst
items.summary: Lumentum Holdings ($LITE) stock fell sharply, extending declines amid 'AI-related angst' despite Marvell Technology agreeing to acquire the company in a $115 billion deal.

items.headline: Marvell Technology Declines on AI Concerns Despite Acquisition Deal
items.summary: Marvell Technology ($MRVL) shares dropped following its announcement to acquire Lumentum, with investors expressing concerns over AI-related spending.

items.headline: Oracle Falls Following $20 Billion Fundraising Announcement
items.summary: Oracle ($ORCL) shares declined after the company announced plans to raise $20 billion through debt and share sales, adding to investor anxiety around AI infrastructure investments.

items.headline: Check Point Software Sinks on Trimmed 2026 Outlook
items.summary: Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. ($CHKP) shares fell after the cybersecurity firm lowered its full-year 2026 revenue and earnings guidance.

items.headline: Energy Sector Leads Gains, Tech Continues to Lag
items.summary: The Energy Select Sector SPDR (XLE) gained 1.9%, making energy stocks the biggest gainers for the day. Conversely, technology remained the worst-performing sector, with the Information Technology Select Sector SPDR (XLK) declining 4.9%, heavily influenced by ongoing concerns about AI spending and recent disappointing earnings. The consumer cyclical sector also showed strength.

items.headline: U.S. Economy Shows Mixed Signals Ahead of Midterm Elections
items.summary: Recent economic data indicated a robust U.S. economy, with third-quarter 2026 Real GDP growing at an annual rate of 3.4%. Manufacturing activity in October was better than expected, although construction spending fell in September. Investors are closely watching the upcoming U.S. midterm elections on November 3, which could impact fiscal policy and market sentiment.

items.headline: Major Earnings Reports Impact Market; Apple, Palantir Due After Close
items.summary: Amazon.com Inc. ($AMZN) reported third-quarter 2026 earnings of $1.89 per share, missing consensus estimates, and its revenues also fell short, contributing to the broader tech sell-off. Alphabet's (Google) shares plunged after it reported its first negative free cash flow as a public company, tied to AI capacity building. Public Service Enterprise Group ($PEG) announced Q3 2026 results that aligned with expectations, reaffirming its full-year guidance. All eyes are now on Apple ($AAPL) and Palantir Technologies ($PLTR), both scheduled to release their quarterly results after the market close today.

items.headline: Oil Prices Tumble on Diplomatic Hopes; AI Spending Under Scrutiny
items.summary: Crude oil prices fell sharply today, with Brent crude dropping over 7%, driven by hopes of diplomatic progress in U.S.-Iran peace talks. Meanwhile, investor skepticism continues regarding the substantial capital expenditures on AI infrastructure across the tech sector and whether these investments will yield sufficient returns.
